newsitem.title: USA: U.S. official blasts Los Angeles subway plan-paper.
newsitem.headline: U.S. official blasts Los Angeles subway plan-paper.

text.p: A top U.S. transit official assailed Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority's $5.9 billion subway recovery plan, according to a published report Thursday.
Federal Transit Administrator Gordon Linton issued a letter that criticized the transportation authority's recovery plan as being unrealistic, the Los Angeles Times reported.
In the letter, Linton said the authority's plan to get the troubled project back on track was riddled with "serious deficiencies and questionable assumptions," the Times reported.
The authority's recovery plan, which delays certain subway projects to save money, was presented to federal transit officials in January.
